actually curious, i’ve used both m1 and starhub 5g before — if they’re sharing the same SA infrastructure, why is there such a big difference in quality of service? aeroplane mode is rare for starhub 5g but for m1 it’s literally occurring so many times everyday
First you need to know 5G NSA and SA are diferent infra. They are sharing SA infra same with MyRepublic SA, Non 5g infra is still thier own and NSA.
i do know that — however aren’t they deploying SA only 5G? from what i know only singtel does SA+NSA

I think the issue is with their 4G services. 5G SA for Starhub and M1 should be similar.
M1 is using 4G and 5G SA, they do not operate 5G NSA, so there is no seamless transition. Whereas like Singtel MVNOs and Simba, they all have 5G NSA, which technically is using 4G cell and upgrade it to 5G.
Hence, when one is out of 5G SA area, the connection goes out, and you don't automatically connect back, hence the aeroplane mode.
means m1 4g is so much worse than starhub 4g…
or maybe it’s the way they do their transition, because the fallback to 4G is quite fast for Starhub
Most probably. If M1 uses 5G NSA alongside SA, there won't be lots of problems.

I was on m1 since before 3G days and the main reason why i left was i spend a considerable amount of time in Serangoon Nex and for some reason there was little to no 4G coverage there. Not sure if its the same now but those planning to switch i suggest you check this out especially if you live in serangoon or go to Nex often.
The main reason why i will not recommend m1 is their flawed billing and what i deem as false advertising. So my mother was on m1 & recently telcos had the option to block incoming overseas calls.
I went into the m1 app to activate that option for her and saw another option to prevent her from accidentally subscribing to 3rd party content like ringtones and other sheet. It clearly said this option was FREE unless I signed up for it, deactivated and activated again.
A month later i noticed she was billed for this “free” service. And i only activated it once cos why would i activate, deactivate & reactivate?
1627 is impossible to get through and there’s no email so i PM them on FB Messenger as i had done before when i had issues with my m1 home broadband.
They said my mother had to PM them instead due to “PDPA regulations”. I told them my mother was a senior citizen and not internet savvy and besides, what PDPA are you talking about when i, or anyone, can create a fake FB account with my mother’s name?
After lots of back and forth they “kindly” agreed to make an exception and arrange for their staff to call my mum. Wah so honoured sia.
They didn’t explain why she was charged for a free service but said will refund her $10.90 in next bill. Refund never came.
Because its such a hassle to contact M1 especially since my mother is not on FB and its such a big deal for their staff to call, we decided to let this slide.
Then last month my mother found she was charged for an IDD call. I checked her call logs and no overseas calls were made or received. WTF?!
That’s when i had enough and switched her to another telco. So yeah no matter how “cheap” their plans are and how “good” their network is, its still not worth the billing problems. Not that m1 is cheap and their network is good lah
